name: Kakyoin Dating Simulator
source:
A dating Simulator in which you one day to woo Kakyoin for Jojo's bizzare adventure. There are two endings.

This is a joke game that didn't have much effort put into it. This game is actually a gift for a friend, so some of the jokes are catered to her taste specifically. Please keep that in mind!
translation:
一款约会模拟器，有一天你会为了Jojo的奇异冒险而向花京院求爱。有两个结局。

这是一个玩笑游戏，并没有投入太多精力。这个游戏其实是送给朋友的礼物，所以有些笑话是专门迎合她的口味的。请记住这一点！
